title: Application will not open
symptom: A business application does not open
user_description: I double-click the program and nothing happens. It worked fine yesterday and I need it for month-end.

options.text: Reinstall every program on her PC
options.why: Huge, slow and unnecessary. One program is failing, so look at that one.

options.text: Download a replacement from a random website
options.why: Unsafe. Unknown downloads can contain malware and break software licensing rules.

options.text: Note the exact error message, try closing and reopening the program, restart the PC, and check whether it fails for others too
options.why: The error message points to the cause. A restart clears many temporary faults, and checking others shows whether it is the PC or the application itself.
Never start with the most destructive fix.

hints: What exactly happens when she opens it? Is there an error message?
real_world_tip: Ask for a screenshot of any error message. It saves guessing and gives you something exact to search for.
